decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The brickwork to be used in the construction of the parapet wall to the southern elevation of the roof terrace hereby permitted shall match that used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (01, 02, 03 and Design and Access Statement [received 14 August 2018]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The glass balustrading approved shall be obscure glazed and installed to the height shown within approved plan 03 received 14 August 2018.
description: Installation of French doors and glass balustrading at third floor level to form a roof terrace to the existing flat
